description: This November, Arizona voters get a long-overdue say on photo radar. I'm asking you to vote YES on Proposition 319 so that we can ban this scam for good. Right now cities can put up speed cameras and red light cameras without ever asking the people who pay the tickets. Prop 319 changes that so
